short_description:
Car got impounded in GTA 6? Two ways back: break into the impound lot (you'll get a wanted level) or pay the Scooter Bros app to deliver it, no cops involved. The app isn't there from the start: it unlocks during the story. Yes, it's the old Scooter Brothers meme, finally useful. No story spoilers. More quick answers: vicereplay.com (Guides).

Sources: GamesRadar, PowerPyx, Space4Games, Digital Citizen.
